remaining_manual_steps_f_scope: Do not repeat endurance or already-evidenced Male Surface recreation. Finish targeted checks in the existing app.

Select Male preview, press actual Android Home, wait5–10seconds, return. Confirm same costume renders, controls respond and background music/ambient returns without doubling. Return to Wretch and verify movement. This also joins audio before next export.
If three actual Home tests have not already been performed, repeat only the remaining count and state that Home was used; exported document-picker pauses are not proof of Home.

Test audio focus while CoH remains resumed/visible: use existing media notification playback or supported split screen to start another media source. Confirm CoH audio interrupts appropriately, then restores after stopping/returning. Record the method; focus_changes must rise to establish callback coverage. Launching another app after Home may only test pause/resume.

If an actual output switch has already been done, state which route and whether audio followed without duplicate sound. Otherwise briefly switch an available headphone/Bluetooth route and back, checking audible recovery; no extended run needed.

After the explicit Home/return and focus/route checks, Export report and share requested screenshots plus observations. Export freezes JSON before document picker pauses the app, so that picker does not checkpoint audio inside the just-exported file.
